_meta.description: 200 body of GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/invites (rest-api.md §7.5.2) from a contracts-0.23.0 server, built from vehicle-sharing.schema.json's own printed examples (MYR-369). Its whole job is the KEY PLACEMENT the schema specifies, which no decode can check for itself: `allowRides` and `suspended` are OWNER-ONLY and ACCEPTED-ROWS-ONLY, so they are present on all three accepted rows and OMITTED ENTIRELY from the pending one. `permission` on an accepted row is DERIVED, never stored — `rides` iff allowRides is true, `live` otherwise — so it agrees with the flag on every row here by construction. `live_history` appears nowhere: it is retired and never emitted (the sibling share_invites_list.json still carries one, as the pre-0.23.0 server it now stands for). The suspended row deliberately keeps allowRides TRUE, which is the state the contract is most specific about: suspension gates everything, so that grant allows nothing, and the flag describes only what would come back on restore. `code`/`shareUrl` remain pending-only and `acceptedAt` accepted-only, unchanged from MYR-184/MYR-368.
